description: Tightened permissions for Clauge menu-bar popover. Only core:default + window-state:default are listed; custom invoke commands defined in src-tauri/src/ipc.rs (get_server_port, set_autostart, get_autostart, check_for_updates) work because no app-level ACL manifest exists. Adding capabilities/app.json or a manifest later will require listing each ipc:: command explicitly.
